_comment: Shared cross-impl test vector for the CapAuth Bunker relay E2E-encryption (capauth-bunker-e2e-v1). Python (cryptography) and JS (WebCrypto) tests read THIS file and assert byte-identical key derivation + AEAD output. Pins the KDF/AEAD parameters so the broker-blind channel never drifts between impls. The ECDH step (X25519) is exercised by per-language round-trip tests; this vector fixes a KNOWN shared secret so the HKDF+AES-GCM layer is deterministic and comparable. Do NOT edit expected_* without regenerating from both impls.

expected._comment_ct: wire ciphertext = nonce(12) || AES-GCM(ciphertext || 16-byte tag), hex-encoded
